title: Testcoveragetarget covers Systemsoftware
description: The target puts platform software the team installs and configures in test scope, such as a database engine, broker or runtime whose installation and configuration infrastructure tests (Testinfra, InSpec, container-structure-test) verify. A code library is not system software: cover the application component instead. Use testcasesketch requires systemsoftware for software a test only runs on, and an environment factor for a version a test matrix varies.
